stem:
Ira watches a lung model. Fresh air fills the alveoli. Thin alveolar walls sit next to blood vessels. Oxygen and carbon dioxide move during gas exchange.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Oxygen from alveolar air passes into blood, and carbon dioxide from blood passes into the alveoli.
Carbon dioxide passes from alveoli into blood, and oxygen passes from blood into alveoli.
Gas exchange at the alveoli needs blood vessels beside the thin walls.

teacher.key_rationale: At the alveoli, oxygen moves from alveolar air into blood and carbon dioxide moves from blood into the alveoli; nearby blood vessels are needed. Statement 2 reverses the gas directions, so only 1 and 3 are correct.
